author: feral-core
description: Generate an image from a text description with OpenAI DALL-E 3. Needs an OpenAI key, read from the vault entry for 'image_gen' or from the OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable; with neither present every call fails with 'No image generation providers configured (set OPENAI_API_KEY)' and no image is produced. There is no keyless fallback provider.

endpoints.description: Generate an image from a text prompt. The image comes back as base64 PNG bytes in 'b64'. The 'url' field is always null: the provider is asked for b64_json, so no hosted URL is ever produced. Do not tell the user you have a link.

params.name: size
params.description: Image size. Only 1024x1024, 1792x1024 and 1024x1792 exist; any other value is silently replaced with 1024x1024 rather than refused. Defaults to 1024x1024.

params.name: style
params.description: vivid or natural. Any other value is silently replaced with vivid. Defaults to vivid.

params.name: n
params.description: Accepted and then ignored: DALL-E 3 generates exactly one image per call, so this never changes the result. Reserved for providers that support batching.

endpoints.returns_description: {b64: base64 PNG bytes, url: always null, revised_prompt: the prompt DALL-E actually rendered, provider, size}
